SINGLEPLAYERCARD-APPLY_IN_MULTIPLAYER.ho: Off by default. When enabled, this mod's changes also apply in multiplayer games: instead of vanilla's multiplayer-exclusive cards, this mod's singleplayer-adapted versions are added to the card pool instead. Every card's Adjusted/Original/Hidden setting below follows the HOST player's configuration for everyone in the session, not each player's own.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONFIG_HOVER_TEXT_ORIGI:
[{rework}] {reworked_card_text}
[{original}] Doesn't work correctly in singleplayer, so it isn't offered here
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-IRONCLAD_CARDS.title: Ironclad Cards
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-DEMONIC_SHIELD.hover.de: Lose 1 HP. Gain Block equal to the HP you've lost this combat. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
Lose 1 HP. Double your Block. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TANK.hover.desc.rework: Take 50% more damage from enemies. Reflect all blocked Attack damage back at the attacker.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIDNIGHT.hover.desc.rew: Deal 36(48) damage. Costs 1 less for each card in your Discard Pile. Costs 2 less this turn for each card Exhausted this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIDNIGHT.hover.desc.xdr: Deal 60(72) damage. Costs 1 less for each card Exhausted this combat.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BLAZE.hover.desc.rework: Gain 2(3) Strength for each card you've discarded this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-OUTRAGE.hover.desc.rewo: Deal 8(11) damage. Add a copy of this card and any copies in your hand to your Discard Pile.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-OUTRAGE.hover.desc.xdro: Deal 9(13) damage. Add a copy of this card to your Discard Pile.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-SILENT_CARDS.title: Silent Cards
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-PINCER_ATTACK.hover.des: This turn, the enemy takes double damage from Attack cards not currently in your hand.
This turn, the enemy takes double Attack damage.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-STEALTH.hover.desc.rewo: Sly. Whenever you deal damage by means other than an Attack card, gain 1(2) Block.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-STEALTH.hover.desc.xdro: Sly. Whenever you attack an enemy, gain 1(2) Block.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BLADE_SYMPHONY.hover.de: Play every Shiv you generated this turn (Upgraded).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONCOCT.hover.desc.rewo: Give all un-enchanted Attack cards in your hand Venomous 1(2).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONCOCT.hover.desc.xdro: This turn, whenever an Attack deals unblocked damage, apply 3(4) Poison.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-SHADOW_VANISH.hover.des: Retain. This turn, gain Dexterity equal to the number of non-Skill cards in your hand. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-REGENT_CARDS.title: Regent Cards
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GENEROUS_GIFT.hover.des: At the start of your next turn, add 1 random (Upgraded) Colorless card to your hand.
Add 1 random (Upgraded) Colorless card to your hand.
Whenever you play Sovereign Blade, replay every card that Forged this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-SCHEME.hover.desc.rewor: Lose the extra card you'd draw at the start of next turn, and draw it now instead.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONSTELLATION.hover.des: At the start of your next turn, draw a card, gain 1 Energy, and gain 9(12) Block.
Draw a card, gain 1 Energy, and gain 9(12) Block.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TUTOR.hover.desc.rework: Choose a card in your Draw Pile to add to your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-NECROBINDER_CARDS.title: Necrobinder Cards
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GLIMPSE_BEYOND.hover.de: At the start of your next 2(3) turns, add a Soul to your hand. Exhaust.
Add 3(4) Souls to your Draw Pile. Exhaust.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-UNDERWORLD.hover.desc.r: This turn, whenever you apply Doom, deal damage equal to that amount. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-UNDERWORLD.hover.desc.x: This turn, whenever an Attack deals damage, apply Doom equal to that damage. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CACOPHONY.hover.desc.re: Every 12 cards drawn, deal 16(24) damage to a random enemy.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CACOPHONY.hover.desc.xd: Every 33 cards drawn, deal 66(99) damage to a random enemy.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-DEFECT_CARDS.title: Defect Cards
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-ENERGY_SURGE.hover.desc: At the start of each of your next 2(3) turns, gain 1 Energy. Exhaust.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-IGNITION.hover.desc.rew: Channel 1 Plasma. Trigger the Passive of all Plasma orbs. Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HIBERNATE.hover.desc.re: At the end of this turn, your Frost triggers its Passive twice. Channel 2(3) Frost.
Your 0 Energy Attacks deal 3(4) additional damage.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-IMITATION_LEARNING.hove: At the end of each of your next 2(3) turns, play a copy of the last Power you played.
The next 2(3) Powers you play are played an extra time.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-COLORLESS_CARDS.title: Colorless Cards
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GANG_UP.hover.desc.rewo: Deal 5 damage. Deal 5(7) additional damage for each Attack you've played this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TAG_TEAM.hover.desc.rew: Deal 11(15) damage. The next Attack you play on the enemy is played an extra time.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-KNOCKDOWN.hover.desc.re: Deal 10(14) damage. Next turn, the enemy takes 2(3)x damage.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-KNOCKDOWN.hover.desc.xd: Deal 10(14) damage. This turn, the enemy takes 2(3)x damage.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-THE_BALL.hover.desc.rew: Deal 10 damage. Increase this card's damage by 5(10) this combat and shuffle it into a random spot in your Draw Pile, Hand, or Discard Pile.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-THE_BALL.hover.desc.xdr: Deal 10 damage. Increase this card's damage by 10(15) this combat and add it to your Draw Pile.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BELIEVE_IN_YOU.hover.de: Gain 2(3) Energy. For the next 2 turns, you cannot gain additional Energy or Draw.
Draw 2 cards. At the start of your next turn, draw 2 more cards.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HELPING_HAND.hover.desc: Double the Block gained from your next card.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-COORDINATE.hover.desc.r: Enchant Training 5(8) to unenchanted card. Exhaust.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-COORDINATE.hover.desc.x: Until end of turn, gain 5(8) Strength.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIMICRY.hover.desc.rewo: Gain Block equal to the highest Block value among cards in your hand (ignoring special effects). Exhaust (except on Upgrade).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GATHER.hover.desc.rewor: Gain Block equal to the sum of the Block values of all other cards in your hand (ignoring special effects).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BEACON_OF_HOPE.hover.de: The first time you gain Block from a card each turn, you gain same Block on next turn.
